ideas.pitch: A web-based interactive tool that compiles and steps through complex data structure operations in real-time, visualizing pointer states and memory allocations.
ideas.problem_statement: Debug Decrypt 3.0: The Ultimate Algorithm Challenge - Algorithmic Challenge and Final Championship round preparation for efficient implementation and logical reasoning.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace: Real-Time Algorithm Execution Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core focus of the hackathon on data structures, algorithms, and debugging. Judges from competitive programming backgrounds will value an internal tool that makes abstract algorithm execution transparent.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered tool that analyzes suboptimal competitive programming submissions, automatically generates edge-case inputs that cause TLE or WA, and suggests algorithmic optimizations.
ideas.problem_statement: Debug Decrypt 3.0: The Ultimate Algorithm Challenge - Testing participants' knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms, programming fundamentals, logical reasoning, and debugging.
ideas.title: CP-Bench: Automated Competitive Programming Test-Case Generator and Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on debugging and algorithmic optimization which directly reflects the primary judging criteria of Debug Decrypt 3.0.

ideas.pitch: A specialized IDE for rapid prototyping and performance benchmarking of graph algorithms under strict time and memory constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: Debug Decrypt 3.0: The Ultimate Algorithm Challenge - Advanced algorithmic challenges focused on optimization, analytical thinking, and efficient implementation.
ideas.title: GraphPath: Interactive Graph Algorithm Playground
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering in performance profiling and algorithm visualization, satisfying the working demo and technical difficulty pattern.

ideas.title: BitWise: Low-Level Memory and Pointer Manipulation Tutor

ideas.pitch: A static analysis tool that parses source code ASTs to automatically deduce the asymptotic time and space complexity of custom data structure implementations.

ideas.title: ComplexityAnalyzer: Static Code Analyzer for Time Complexity Estimation
